summary: 涂鸦的介质和附着表面各异，清除前须先评估材料，避免对建筑造成更大损伤。文章比较水洗、化学和机械清除手段，再讨论阻隔、可移除保护涂层等预防方法。
logic: 评估表面并从温和方法开始

paragraphs.brief: `graffiti ' 一词源自意大利语“fraffio”一词的意思是“crattaching”，可以定义为未经邀请而刮伤或用于物体、建筑结构和自然特征的标记或写作。
sentences: The term ‘graffiti’ derives from the Italian word graffio meaning ‘scratching’, and can be defined as uninvited markings or writing scratched or applied to objects, built structures, and natural features.
`graffiti ' 一词源自意大利语“fraffio”一词的意思是“crattaching”，可以定义为未经邀请而刮伤或用于物体、建筑结构和自然特征的标记或写作。
It is not a new phenomenon; examples can be found on ancient structures around the world, in some cases predating the Greeks and Romans.
它不是一个新现象；世界各地古老的结构中可以找到一些例子，有时先于希腊人和罗马人。
In such circumstances, it has acquired invaluable historical and archaeological significance as it provides a social history of life and events at that time.
在这种情况下，它具有宝贵的历史和考古意义，因为它为当时的生活和事件提供了社会历史。
This is not true of more recent graffiti, which has become a pervasive problem particularly over the last 50 years, as a result of the availability of cheap and quick means of mark-making.
最近涂鸦的情况并非如此，最近涂鸦已成为一个普遍的问题，特别是在过去50年中，因为有廉价和快速的标记手段。
These include the ubiquitous spray paints.
其中包括无处不在的喷雾涂料。

paragraphs.brief: 其原因之一是防止 " 影印猫 " 的模拟，一旦清洁表面被毁，这种模拟就会迅速发生，因此，许多公司和理事会都有一项政策，要在报告的时间里一两个小时之内清除涂鸦。
sentences: Graffitists, the people who are responsible for creating graffiti, are indiscriminate about the surfaces they choose.
涂鸦创作者不分青红皂白地看待他们选择的表面。
Wherever graffiti appears, it is usually considered a priority to remove it as quickly as possible.
凡是出现涂鸦的地方，通常都把尽快清除涂鸦视为优先事项。

One reason for this is to prevent ‘copy-cat’ emulation, which can occur rapidly once a clean surface is defaced, and so many companies and councils have a policy of removing graffiti within an hour or two of it being reported.
其原因之一是防止 " 影印猫 " 的模拟，一旦清洁表面被毁，这种模拟就会迅速发生，因此，许多公司和理事会都有一项政策，要在报告的时间里一两个小时之内清除涂鸦。
Another reason is that as paints, glues, and inks dry out, they can become increasingly difficult to remove.
另一个原因是，由于油漆、胶水和墨水干涸，它们可能越来越难以去除。

A more important factor, however, is that graffiti can lead to more serious forms of vandalism and, ultimately, to the deterioration of a neighborhood area, and in this way contributes to a general social decline.
但更重要的是，涂鸦可能导致更严重的破坏行为，并最终导致一个居民区的恶化，从而导致社会普遍衰落。
For this reason, the police like to be notified of new graffiti incidents.
因此，警方喜欢接到新的涂鸦事件通知。
To aid in achieving a successful prosecution, they encourage owners of properties to take photographs of any new graffiti, as there could be other related incidents occurring locally.
为了帮助成功起诉，他们鼓励房产所有人拍摄任何新的涂鸦照片，因为当地可能发生其他相关事件。
An incidence pattern can help to identify possible culprits, as can their ‘tag’—the distinctive mark graffitists leave to show the graffiti is their work.
一个事件模式可以帮助识别可能的罪犯，以及他们的"标签" - - 涂师留下来表现出涂的独特标志是他们的作品。

paragraphs.brief: 第一步是进行清理试验，以确定哪种方法适合清除涂鸦介质，哪种方法对现场表面的影响最小。
sentences: Any proposal to remove graffiti has to be carefully considered because techniques designed for robust or utilitarian surfaces may result in considerable damage to older, more historic buildings.
任何清除涂鸦的建议都必须仔细考虑，因为为坚固或功利表面设计的技术可能会对老旧、历史更悠久的建筑物造成相当大的损害。
Consequently, as no two sites are the same, there is no one treatment which will be suitable for all situations; each site must be looked at individually.
因此，由于两个地点没有相同，因此没有一种适合所有情况的治疗方法；每个地点都必须单独检查。
The owners of some graffiti-affected sites may wish to attempt their own treatment, whereas others may prefer to contact a specialist contractor.
一些受涂鸦影响地点的业主可能希望尝试自己的治疗，而另一些人则可能更愿意与专家承包商联系。
However, whichever course is decided on, it is important to follow a systematic approach.
然而，无论决定采取什么方针，都必须采取系统的做法。
The first step is to carry out cleaning trials to see which method is suitable for the removal of the graffiti media used, and also which method has the least impact on the site surface.
第一步是进行清理试验，以确定哪种方法适合清除涂鸦介质，哪种方法对现场表面的影响最小。

These trials should be carried out on a small unobtrusive area if possible and should always start with the least aggressive cleaning method, usually water, and stop once a successful method has been found.
这些试验应尽可能在小型无侵扰区进行，而且应始终从最不积极的清洁方法开始，通常是用水，一旦找到成功的方法，就停止。

paragraphs.brief: 除水外，还可以使用各种方法清除涂鸦；这些涂鸦大致分为化学和机械系统。
sentences: Apart from water, a variety of methods can be used to remove graffiti; broadly, these are divided into chemical and mechanical systems.
除水外，还可以使用各种方法清除涂鸦；这些涂鸦大致分为化学和机械系统。
When using either of these systems, care must be taken with regard to protecting both passers-by and the person carrying out the graffiti removal.
在使用这两种系统之一时，必须注意保护过路人和清除涂鸦的人。
Chemical preparations are based on dissolving the graffiti media; these solvents can range from mild to potentially dangerous chemical ‘cocktails’.
化学制剂的基础是拆除涂鸦介质；这些溶剂可以是温和的，也可以是危险的化学“鸡尾酒”。
When using chemicals, it is important to wear protective clothing, take measures to minimize any run-off of potentially harmful chemicals, and avoid the drifting of aerial mists.
在使用化学品时，必须穿戴防护服，采取措施尽量减少潜在有害化学品的任何径流，并避免空中喷雾漂流。
Mechanical systems are often in the form of wire-brushing and grit blasting, which attempt to chip off the graffiti media.
机械系统往往采取钢丝刷和坚硬的爆破形式，试图粉碎涂鸦媒体。
Operators of mechanical systems must also wear protective clothing to avoid being hurt by hard airborne particles.
机械系统的操作人员还必须穿戴防护服，以避免受到硬性空气颗粒的伤害。
This method often leaves marks on a surface.
这种方法往往在表面留下痕迹。

paragraphs.brief: 可以采取不同措施，解决反复出现的涂鸦问题。
sentences: Different measures can be adopted to combat a recurring problem of graffiti.
可以采取不同措施，解决反复出现的涂鸦问题。
It is clear that protection measures will ultimately be more successful and less damaging than multiple removal treatments.
显然，保护措施最终将比多重驱离治疗更成功，更没有破坏性。

Popular places for graffiti are often readily accessible flat surfaces where the graffiti will have an instant impact, but this is not always the case, and graffitists may scale bridges to give their work greater prominence.
涂鸦的流行场所往往是易于进入的平面，涂鸦将立即产生影响，但情况并非总是如此，涂鸦可能会扩大桥梁，使其工作更加突出。
Possible protection measures may include a combination of floodlighting to illuminate dark areas and surveillance systems such as closed-circuit television.
可能采取的保护措施可包括将照明黑暗地区的防洪照明与闭路电视等监视系统相结合。
Research has shown that prominently placed cameras can reduce the incidence of graffiti in areas with a recurring problem.
研究显示，显着安装的照相机可以减少经常出现问题的地区涂鸦的发生率。

Unfortunately, the cost of any of these measures may be too high, and so physical obstacles such as fences, railings, doors, or gates can be introduced to discourage unauthorized access, though in some cases, these obstacles simply provide a new surface for graffiti.
不幸的是，任何这些措施的费用都可能太高，因此，可以设置诸如栅栏、栏杆、门或门等有形障碍，以阻止未经授权的出入，尽管在某些情况下，这些障碍只是为涂鸦提供了新的表面。

paragraphs.brief: 另一项战略是采用可移动的反刮擦屏障布置，作为预防措施的一种形式。
sentences: Another strategy is to apply a removable anti-graffiti barrier-coating as a form of preventive measure.
另一项战略是采用可移动的反刮擦屏障布置，作为预防措施的一种形式。
Although this will not stop graffiti being applied, it will make its removal much easier and usually only involves using water, which reduces the possibility of damage to the site surface.
虽然这不会停止涂鸦的使用，但它将更容易去除涂鸦，而且通常只涉及用水，从而减少对场地表面的破坏。
Barrier coatings are usually applied by brush or spray, leaving a thin veneer that essentially serves to isolate the graffiti from the surface.
屏障涂层通常使用刷子或喷雾法，留下一个薄的外壳，基本上可以将涂鸦与表面隔开。
So, although there is no prescription for dealing with every graffiti incident, there are some steps that can be taken to minimize the impact of graffiti and to protect vulnerable surfaces.
因此，尽管没有处理每一起涂鸦事件的处方，但可以采取一些步骤，尽量减少涂鸦的影响，保护脆弱的表面。

items.en: A suggestion that might assist in bringing an effective legal action against graffitists
items.zh: 可能有助于对涂鸦行为采取有效法律行动的建议
items.why: 题干关键词是 effective legal action against graffitists,对应原文里的 successful prosecution (成功起诉)。这是非常直接的同义替换。并且原文说的“拍照”就是一种建议，所以答案在 B段。

items.en: An explanation why all instances of graffiti cannot be removed in the same way
items.zh: 解释为什么无法以同样的方式消除所有涂鸦事件
items.why: 题干说的是 all instances of graffiti cannot be removed in the same way。C段明确解释原因: 不同地点情况不同，所以不能一刀切。这里的 no one treatment suitable for all situations 就是题干的直接对应。

items.en: An argument that graffiti can have a negative effect on community life
items.zh: 有关涂鸦会对社区生活产生负面影响的论点
items.why: B段指出涂鸦可能发展为更严重的破坏行为，最终造成社区环境恶化。

items.en: An admission that some strategies for tackling graffiti may lead to an increase in graffiti
items.zh: 承认一些处理涂鸦的战略可能导致涂鸦的增加
items.why: E段承认围栏等阻隔措施有时反倒为涂鸦提供新的表面，正是防治措施可能适得其反的例子。

items.en: Some risks people face when graffiti is being removed
items.zh: 有些人在涂鸦被清除时会面临风险
items.why: 题干是 risks people face when graffiti is being removed。D段专门讲清除时的安全问题: 化学法会有有害化学物、漂浮雾滴。机械法会有硬颗粒飞散伤人。所以答案是 D段。

items.en: The article gives details about different methods of removing graffiti. Which TWO points are made by the writer of this article?
items.zh: 文章详细介绍了消除涂鸦的不同方法。文章作者提出了哪些两点？
correct: An inconspicuous part of a surface should be used to test a cleaning method.
应使用表面不明的部分来测试清洁方法。
Localised pollution can result from some cleaning methods.
某些清洁方法可能造成局部污染。

items.en: The writer describes ways of combating a recurring problem of graffiti. Which TWO of these ideas are mentioned by the writer?
items.zh: 作者描述了如何解决反复出现的涂鸦问题。作者提到了其中哪两种想法？
correct: Ensuring surfaces are visible and monitored both day and night
确保表面可见，日夜监测
Adding a covering layer that graffiti cannot penetrate
添加涂鸦无法穿透的覆盖层

items.en: Ancient graffiti is studied because it records a ________ of the culture of that period.
items.zh: 研究者之所以研究古代涂鸦，是因为它记录了那个时期文化的一个________。
items.why: 回到对应内容“在这种情况下，它具有宝贵的历史和考古意义，因为它为当时的生活和事件提供了社会历史”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: The unique signature of graffitists, known as a ________, can assist police in finding and prosecuting them.
items.zh: 涂鸦者独有的签名叫作________，它能帮助警方找到并起诉涂鸦者。
items.why: 题干说 The unique signature of graffitists, 原文明确解释这个独特标记叫 tag。这是原词重现。

items.en: Operators of both chemical and mechanical graffiti removal systems must have ________.
items.zh: 无论采用化学还是机械方法清除涂鸦，操作人员都必须配备________。
items.why: 题干中的 operators of both…systems 对应D段两处共同要求: 两类操作人员都要穿 protective clothing。答案不能写 clothing 或 protection,最准确完整的是原文短语。

items.en: Surfaces treated with a barrier-coating can normally be cleaned with ________.
items.zh: 经过隔离涂层处理的表面，通常只需用________就能洗净。
items.why: F段明确说 barrier-coating 后，清除通常只需 water。答案直接来自原文。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空最多填两个词。

pairs: 对社区的负面作用／社区状况恶化
Adding a covering layer that graffiti cannot penetrate
阻挡涂鸦渗入的保护涂层
points: 题干是 risks people face when graffiti is being removed。D段专门讲清除时的安全问题: 化学法会有有害化学物、漂浮雾滴。机械法会有硬颗粒飞散伤人。所以答案是 D段。
F段明确说 barrier-coating 后，清除通常只需 water。答案直接来自原文。
clauses: Any proposal to remove graffiti has to be carefully considered ….
连接词 because 引出“because techniques designed for robust or utilitarian surfaces may result in considerable damage to older, more historic buildings”，说明主句的原因关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 because 把这一层关系补进去。
Popular places for graffiti are often readily accessible flat surfaces …, but this is not always the case, and graffitists may scale bridges to give their work greater prominence.
“where the graffiti will have an instant impact”修饰前面的 surfaces。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 where 时，回看 surfaces，再把修饰信息接回主句。
